caption: The drawing shows a sleeveless vest rendered primarily in a light beige or cream color on a plain background. The vest features a high, straight collar and an asymmetrical front that slopes downward, with one side overlapping the other which is fastened with a row of closely spaced, round buttons. Both the collar and the edges of the garment are outlined and decorated with fine, dark embroidery, which also creates small floral or dot-like motifs scattered evenly over the front. The bottom edge of the vest is adorned with a border of more intricate and denser embroidery, forming geometric and vegetal patterns. To the right of the main illustrated vest, there is a simple line drawing showing the back view of the vest, unembellished and indicated with minimal detail, including seam lines and small notches at the bottom hem. The drawing is executed in ink and watercolor, mainly utilizing soft tones and precise linework.
title: Waistcoat
